policy.weather: Open-Meteo city-level proxy nearest hourly forecast to kickoff; timestamped snapshots
policy.weather_evidence_time: PREMATCH_FROZEN only when captured_at_utc < kickoff_utc; post-kickoff rows are never prematch-usable
policy.postmatch_weather: POSTMATCH_FACTUAL may exist only for research/audit and is excluded from prematch latest views
policy.rotation: official current XI compared only with official previous-match XI
policy.missing_previous_xi: rotation metrics left blank; never inferred
policy.xi_polling: only inside final 90 minutes; workflow cadence handles re-checks until official XI appears
